segments: Today we're going to talk about something that really happened to you.
I'll go first and then it'll be your turn.

I was worried I'd be late.

It came out in the apple!
Where were you when it happened?
What did you do with the tooth?
Grandad put it in a bag.

Let me say your story back to you.

labelled_transcript: Therapist. Hi there. Today we're going to talk about something that really happened to you. I'll go first and then it'll be your turn. This morning I spilled my cereal because the bowl was too full, so I had to clean the whole table. I was worried I'd be late. Okay, now it's your turn. Child. My tooth came out. Therapist. Your tooth came out! Who was with you? Child. My grandad. He was looking after me. Therapist. Your grandad was looking after you. What happened? Child. I was eating an apple. And it came out. In the apple. Therapist. It came out in the apple! How did you feel? Child. Surprised. It didn't hurt. Therapist. Surprised, and it didn't hurt. Where were you when it happened? Child. Um. Don't know. Therapist. That's okay. What did you do with the tooth? Child. Grandad put it in a bag. A little bag. Therapist. In a little bag. Then what? Child. I showed my mum. She said wow. Therapist. You showed your mum and she said wow. You must have been so excited. How did it all end? Child. Can't remember. Therapist. That's okay. Let me say your story back to you. Your grandad was looking after you, and you were eating an apple when your tooth came out in the apple. You were surprised, and it didn't hurt. Grandad put it in a little bag, and you showed your mum, and she said wow. Did I get that right? Child. Yeah. Therapist. Thanks for telling me your story. You did a really great job.
